about: Links to a route by the identifier a manifest declared it under, which the application's own types do not know. The identifier is resolved through the route map when the link draws, so a page that moves keeps its links.
before: A control is drawn from a recipe, and its page is where the axes are listed. Open

inline.about: A link reads as the words around it and carries the ink of a link, so a sentence keeps its line.
inline.title: In a sentence

resolving.about: One link per identifier, each resolved through the map the router holds. Follow one and the address in the bar is the page's own, because the identifier is what moved, not the path.
resolving.title: Resolving an identifier
